Benda-benda yang wajib buat when starting a business in Malaysia:

1. Get your business registered with SSM (Sole Prop, Partnership, or Sdn Bhd).

2. Open a business bank account (SSM cert needed).

3. Register your tax file with LHDN.

4. Get necessary licenses/permits ikut industry (e.g. Majlis Pembandaran, Halal cert etc).

5. Set up payment options (FPX, Bank Transfer) 

6. Build your online presence (social media + website).

7. Network & explore grants (MaGIC, SME Corp).

What else? 👀

3. Taxation – Even u are not a tax expert yet, tahu the basics will help you.
